_about: Assumption register for the Trinity Residential Design Studies. Every dimension, area rule, and planning ratio used by studies/plans/*.json and studies/model/*.json cites an id from this file. 'reference' means a benchmark read from owner-supplied third-party drawings (not published); 'sourced' means the value comes from a cited public source; 'exploratory' means it is an authored working assumption with no measured basis and must be replaced by measured or professionally reviewed values before any reliance. Nothing here is a code requirement or a verified dimension.
